We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world's leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new ones.

Job Description Great data only matters if it arrives. Gracenote's delivery platform moves millions of pieces of TV entertainment data every day into the backend systems of the world's leading cable, OTT, CE, and digital companies, powering entertainment experiences used by hundreds of millions of consumers.

We are hiring a Director of Product Management to own this platform from our Bengaluru product and engineering center. You will set the product vision and roadmap for our Unified Data Delivery Platform, the centralized repository that consolidates diverse data from across Gracenote into a single Source of Truth, and for the full family of Video metadata delivery solutions that carry that data to clients worldwide. You will lead a team of two product managers in India and partner daily with our engineering teams to deliver against that roadmap.

Delivery is its own discipline. It is where Gracenote's data meets client systems, with all of the schema, integration, scale, and reliability challenges that implies. It is also the tip of the spear. When something goes wrong for a client, delivery hears about it first and is expected to lead the debugging. We are looking for a leader who has lived in this problem space and knows what it takes to run a delivery platform that clients trust.

Responsibilities

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Unified Data Delivery Platform, the new platform being built to deliver all of Gracenote's Video data to clients and partners
* Own the portfolio of Video metadata delivery solutions that clients rely on today
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of two product managers in India
* Collaborate with clients and partners to understand the business problems of delivering and ingesting TV entertainment data into their backend solutions, and turn that insight into a clear product vision and roadmap
* Travel to the US and Europe a couple of times per year to meet clients and partners face to face, building the direct market understanding that informs the product vision
* Partner with engineering teams, external partners, and internal stakeholders to prioritize and deliver the roadmap
* Work closely with UX and engineering to deliver the configuration and analytics tools that make the platform successful for clients and internal teams
* Serve as the senior product escalation point when delivery issues arise, leading root cause analysis and driving resolution with engineering and client-facing teams
* Work with senior management to identify opportunities and risks, including new products, infrastructure strategy, and quality initiatives
* Closely manage the cloud infrastructure and costs associated with the data platform

 **Qualifications**  

* 12+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years owning data delivery, distribution, or client integration products
* Experience managing and mentoring product managers

New Relic gives engineering teams real-time insight into their software and infrastructure, so they can find and fix problems fast. The Pipeline Control team builds and runs the product that manages customers’ telemetry pipelines: ingesting, routing, transforming and delivering telemetry at GB/s scale. If those pipelines are slow or down, our customers notice.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own services in production end to end: you’ll build them, deploy them, monitor them and support them. You’ll work with Go, Java, Kafka, Kubernetes and AWS, and grow your skills in large-scale observability systems.

* Build and operate big-data-scale pipeline services that ingest, route, transform and deliver telemetry at GB/s throughput.

* Mentor teammates through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and help raise the team’s engineering standards.
* Own your services in production: observability, on-call, incident response and performance tuning.
* Work with product and other engineering teams to turn customer needs into well-scoped technical work.

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years building distributed, high-throughput data systems (streaming or batch pipelines).
* Strong production experience in Go and/or Java, and willingness to work in both.
* A solid grounding in distributed systems: partitioning, backpressure, delivery guarantees, failure handling and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience with Kafka (or an equivalent such as Kinesis or Pulsar), Kubernetes, and a major cloud provider (AWS preferred).
* Experience designing and owning services from design doc through rollout and operation.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions.
* BTech/BE/MTech/ME in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

**Bonus points if you have**

* + OpenTelemetry experience, especially the Collector (receivers, processors, exporters) and OpAMP.
  + Familiarity with Apache Iceberg, Parquet and query engines.
  + Background in observability (logs, metrics, traces) or building telemetry pipelines.

Position Type

Full Time

Career area

Software Engineering

Location

4/F, WeWork, Embassy GolfLinks, Karnataka, Karnātaka 560093, India

Job ID

R-97104

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**

You will be a part of the larger Global Technology organization working on Nike’s internal Consumer Product & Innovation tools, part of our Engineering team and report to the team’s Engineering Director. You will spend much of your time with Software Engineers in CPI Engineering and adjacent teams. You will also partner closely with other Principal Engineers, Solution Architects, Engineering Directors, 3D artists and Product Managers in both Product Innovation and other departments cross geographies.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer to solve complex software engineering problems supporting Nike’s pursuit of delivering state of the art tools to our product developers and broader creation community. The candidate needs to be highly collaborative with peers, productive in a fast-paced development environment and have depth of native cloud software engineering experience.

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

If this is you, you’ll be working on the Consumer Product Innovation team and be one of the primary technical leaders on one of Nike’s emerging technology platforms. In a typical week, half of your time will be spent leading by example to design, develop, operate, and integrate Nike and partner platforms and applications. The other half will be leadership responsibilities to drive technical priorities, define engineering best practices, collaborate with peers, and help to translate business problems into technical solutions.

* Excellent computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.

* 14+ years of software engineering experience as an individual contributor developing custom software.

* 5+ years hands-on experience implementing and supporting modern software

architectural principles and patterns (REST, domain-driven design, Devops, microservices, etc)

* 5+ years hands on experience with distributed cloud systems (node.js, EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, or Google Cloud/Azure equivalents)

* Experience with front-end web application technologies (javascript, CSS, html5, Vue, React/redux, etc.)

* Preferred: Deep familiarity with 3D content creation tools (e.g., Maya, Blender, Substance, Unity, Unreal) and 3D pipelines used in product design and digital twin workflows.

* Preferred: Experience integrating AI/ML solutions into creative or design tools.

* Continuous deployment and automated testing experience

* Excellent influencing, verbal and written communication skills

* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple peers and cross- functional partners

* Responsible for staying up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in frontend development. You continuously evaluate new tools, frameworks, and techniques, and assess their potential impact on the team's productivity and the quality of the final product.

* Experience working in a technical leadership role with agile teams in a product model.

* Experience developing, monitoring, and supporting highly available micro-

services/lambda's and applications

* Demonstrated ability and experienced professional who not only possesses deep

technical knowledge but also excels in leadership and mentorship. They are responsible for setting technical standards, providing guidance, and ensuring the successful delivery of projects. Experience working in a technical leadership role with agile teams in a product model

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

What You Can Expect

**OUR HIRING GAME PLAN**
------------------------

### **01 Apply**

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

### **02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment**

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

* Review contractor bills, measurements, and work completion certifications.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports for project management.
* Support testing, commissioning, and project handover activities.

Required Qualifications

* Master's Degree in Construction Management will be an added advantage.
